properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Side Sheet
description: Supplementary content along the side of the screen. Standard (an inline, non-modal region that sits beside your content) or modal (a fixed overlay with a scrim and a focus trap), anchored to either logical edge, with an optional back affordance for nested flows.

notes: Dedicated native side sheet: standard (in-flow, no scrim) and modal variants on the start or end side, attached or detached; all twelve properties, mdOpen/mdClose/mdCancel/mdBack with null payloads, show/close/whenClosed through AWCSideSheetController, all five slots, nine appearance hooks and nine typed part targets.

Shared modal layer: one owner stack for dialogs and sheets (only the top owner handles Escape/back, Tab and scrim dismissal; content under an open modal is inert; focus moves in on open and is restored on close, forwarded when a lower owner closes first) and the source z-index paint order, measured against Chrome in thirteen mixed-stack runs.
Outside an AWCModalScope the component keeps the previous platform presentation (a SwiftUI sheet / a Compose dialog window).
macOS SwiftUI/AppKit and Android emulator renderers are verified against the Chrome oracles; iOS SDK, simulator/device and VoiceOver/TalkBack execution remain unverified.
